'''Denezel''' is the [[innkeeper]] of [[The Happy Throng]] in [[Caemlyn]].

==Appearance==
Master Denezel is a tall, young man with a lean face who keeps his head shaved.{{ref/book|13|47}}

==Activities==
Master Denezel opens one of his private rooms of his inn to [[Thomdril Merrilin]], [[Matrim Cauthon]], and [[Perrin Aybara]] and serves them wine as the group share their stories.{{ref/book|13|47}} Perrin has plans with Thom and Mat to meet again at Master Denezel's inn when the two return from the [[Tower of Ghenjei]].{{ref/book|13|53}}

==Parallel==
Master Denezel is a tribute to [http://www.dragonmount.com/forums/user/2-jason/ Jason Denzel], webmaster of the happy throng over at [http://www.dragonmount.com Dragonmount.com]
